# VoiceJournal — AI Mood Diary

Canonical: https://dasgroupllc.com/apps/voicejournal/
Provider: Das Group LLC (https://dasgroupllc.com/)
Last updated: 2026-08-18

## What is it?

VoiceJournal is a private voice-first journaling app for iPhone and iPad. A user speaks a reflection. On-device speech recognition transcribes the audio. On-device sentiment analysis adds a mood label, sentiment score, and topics. The result is an editable, searchable journal entry stored locally on the device.

It is a reflection tool. It is not a medical device, therapist, diagnosis, or treatment.

## Who is it for?

- People who want to journal but find typing too much friction
- People who want a private mood diary without uploading journal content to cloud AI
- People who want a daily check-in, streak, or On This Day memory habit
- iPhone and iPad users on iOS 17.2 or later who prefer voice, Siri, or Shortcuts over a blank text box

## What problem does it solve?

Most journaling apps require typing, so people quit. Voice memos capture speech but do not become a searchable mood diary. Cloud AI journals may upload personal writing for analysis. VoiceJournal lets the user talk, then keeps transcription, mood reflection, and history on the device.

## What it is not

- Not a cloud AI chatbot or therapy session
- Not a diagnosis or mental-health treatment
- Not a social journal, public feed, or shared diary
- Not an export-first document app; the core job is private spoken reflection

## Platforms

- iPhone and iPad
- iOS 17.2 or later
- Siri and Shortcuts support for starting a voice entry and checking stats
- Home Screen streak widget

## How it works

1. Start recording in the app, or start a new voice entry with Siri or Shortcuts.
2. Speak. Live transcription uses Apple Speech with on-device recognition required.
3. Stop. The user can edit the transcript before saving.
4. VoiceJournal adds mood reflection, a sentiment score, and topics from the words.
5. The entry is stored locally. Later surfaces include search, bookmarks, On This Day, daily check-ins, a 3-day reflection challenge, streaks, and mood trends.

## Key features

- Voice-first journaling with live on-device transcription
- On-device mood reflection and topic extraction
- Searchable journal history
- On This Day historical replay
- Daily check-in prompts
- 3-day reflection challenge
- Journaling streaks
- Home Screen streak widget
- Siri / Shortcuts: start a journal entry, journal stats, recent mood
- Audio playback of recordings (Pro)

## Pricing

Free download through the App Store.

Free tier:
- First saved voice entry
- Today's mood and topics
- 7-day mood history snapshot

VoiceJournal Pro (auto-renewable subscription or lifetime purchase, USD):
- Monthly: $5.99
- Yearly: $39.99
- Lifetime: $79.99

Pro unlocks:
- Unlimited voice entries
- Audio playback
- Full mood history
- Weekly emotional patterns / full topic analysis

Local App Store prices may vary. Purchases are processed by Apple.

## Privacy / data handling

- Journal content is stored locally on the device.
- Transcription requires on-device speech recognition and does not send journal audio or text to a cloud AI service.
- Anonymous product analytics and subscription events do not include journal content.
- No account is required to start journaling.
- See the privacy policy: https://dasgroupllc.com/apps/privacy/
- See the App Store privacy label for the current Apple disclosure.

## FAQ

Q: What is VoiceJournal?
A: A private voice journal for iPhone and iPad. You speak; the app transcribes on-device and adds mood reflection and topics.

Q: Does VoiceJournal work offline?
A: Yes for recording, transcription, and mood analysis. Those run on the device.

Q: Does VoiceJournal upload journal entries?
A: No. Journal content is not sent to a cloud AI service.

Q: Is it free?
A: Free to download with a first saved entry and a 7-day mood snapshot. Pro adds unlimited entries, audio playback, full mood history, and weekly patterns.

Q: Can I start with Siri?
A: Yes. Siri and Shortcuts can open a new voice entry. Stats and recent mood intents are also available.

Q: Is this therapy?
A: No. VoiceJournal is a personal reflection tool, not medical advice or treatment.
